purpose: Selection-adjusted historical audit; not an untouched historical test of the previously researched feature universe or raw model.
candidate_family: Every subset of the seven active flags, summed into one fitted term; market movement and availability included together or omitted. Raw-model logit and intercept always included. No held member, threshold search, manual flip, or post-result family expansion.
training: For outer year Y, fit candidates on all earlier seasons plus weeks 1-6 of Y-1.
selection: Choose minimum Brier on weeks 7-10 of Y-1 using fixed ridge 0.001; ties prefer fewer included signals, no market, then lexical candidate id.
validation: Refit the selected feature set on all data through week 10 of Y-1 for each declared ridge; choose minimum Brier on weeks 11-14 of Y-1; ties prefer stronger regularization.
calibration: Refit selected features and ridge on all data through week 14 of Y-1. Fit two-parameter logit calibration only on weeks 15-18 of Y-1. Fixed-combination comparator uses the same chronology and fixed ridge 0.001. Raw-calibrated comparator calibrates raw probability only on the same weeks 15-18.
fixed_forward: Use the already saved chronological_home_probability from the original fixed feature recipe, fitted on prior seasons; retained as descriptive serving-recipe reference.
disagreement_null: Exact two-sided binomial fair-coin null on decisive disagreements; descriptive, assumes independent games. Clustered uncertainty comes from the paired week bootstrap.
decision: Report every arm, fold, selection result, coefficient, apparent-versus-outer gap and paired result. No automatic serving change or signal closure. Unresolved cells must be recorded with weak-signals record; intervals crossing zero do not close a signal.
limitations: The seven signal definitions, their signs and cutoffs, market feature design and raw-model recipe were developed using these historical seasons.
Nested selection controls this declared subset and ridge search only; it cannot erase earlier human research choices.
Two outer seasons do not establish long-run season stability.
Week 3 outcomes are not used for choosing this family, its parameters or the outer windows.

Selection, validation and calibration blocks contain only four weeks each. Report fitted coefficient instability and development-versus-outer gaps; do not convert a small-block calibration failure into rejection of an individual signal.
